query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                       SELECT 1 FROM (
                           SELECT parent_entity_type, parent_entity_id, deleted_at
                           FROM comms_messages WHERE id = $1 LIMIT 1
                       ) m
                       WHERE m.parent_entity_type = 'channel'
                         AND m.parent_entity_id = $2 AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
                   ) AS "found!"
